findings.title: Inherited excessive aggregate provider wait
findings.root_cause: Four sequential independent 22000-ms provider requests; existing fallback withheld until all fail.
findings.remediation: Shared 20000-ms aggregate provider budget, each attempt <= min(8000, remaining); preserve fallback and response semantics.

findings.title: No client RPC deadline or transport cancellation
findings.root_cause: Loading clears only on RPC settlement; no signal or watchdog; cleanup only suppresses writes.
findings.remediation: 25000-ms client watchdog with explicit UI settlement, RPC AbortController and abort on cleanup/replacement; retain stale guards.

findings.title: Missing cumulative-timeout and cross-mode lifecycle tests; missing mirror observability
findings.root_cause: Existing outage tests reject immediately and do not enforce elapsed budgets or discovery RPC liveness; mirror errors swallowed without timing logs.
findings.remediation: Permanent slow/abort/body/transport/lifecycle regressions and bounded structured provider/source/outcome telemetry.
